title: A member who already paid for MettleUp Plus can be shown the buy buttons again and charged a second time
what: The app decides whether to show the buy buttons only from what it remembers on the phone. After Erase all data it forgets the purchase and only asks Google Play again the next time the app is started fresh; the same happens when Google Play did not answer at start. In that gap the member sees the monthly, yearly and for-life buttons again. A member with the for-life plan who taps monthly, or a monthly member who taps for life, is charged again by Google Play, and nothing warns them. A monthly member who taps yearly is told Thank you and the app then says they pay every year, while Google Play keeps charging every month.
expected: Before showing the buy buttons, the app asks Google Play what this account already owns; a member who already owns Plus is told so and is never offered a second plan, and a tap that Google Play answers with already owned keeps the plan they really have.
how_often: rare: after Erase all data, or when Google Play did not answer at app start; nobody today because buying is switched off
fix_line: Ask Google Play what the account owns each time the Plus screen opens and hide the buy buttons for an owner; on already owned, keep the plan Google Play has, not the one tapped

title: Someone who stops working at a gym keeps every paid feature free for good
what: Once a person proves with the admin-app PIN that they are a gym owner or desk staff, the phone remembers it and gives every MettleUp Plus feature free. Nothing ever checks again: if the owner removes them as staff, or the gym leaves MettleUp, the phone still says You work at that gym and keeps everything open until the app data is erased. The gym-member unlock, by contrast, follows the gym's list and ends 7 days after the plan ends.
expected: The staff unlock is checked again from time to time, like the gym-member unlock, and ends when the person is no longer staff at a MettleUp gym.
how_often: every time someone leaves a gym's staff, once Plus is switched on
fix_line: Re-check the staff proof with the server once a launch and drop the unlock when it no longer holds

items.reason: Plus prices, free month, buy, restore and the Play module read. Prices come from one shared list and Google Play's own price words (tax-included in India, so no GST line is needed). Two new faults; purchases kept only on the phone (FN-L5-phone-screens-2-02), refunds page silent on Plus (FN-L5-phone-screens-2-03, promise P-A7-legal-2-73) and a running plan hidden behind the gym unlock (FN-L5-phone-screens-1-01) already exist. The Credits page (F-phone-1729) lists drawings and fonts, not money.

Real Google Play is used only when the payments-live switch is on; otherwise a QA build gets a stand-in store that says no money is taken, and store builds say buying opens soon. Only the QA device workflow writes the stand-in into the build. The test words follow the store kind, not the build. No fault found.

Cancelled, pending, failed, unavailable and already-owned answers and their words read; purchases are acknowledged at once. Late Play answers (pending confirmed, cancelled, refunded, expired) only reach the app on a fresh start: existing FN-L5-phone-screens-1-02 and FN-L5-phone-screens-2-01. Already owned is taken as the plan tapped: new FN-L5-phone-lib-core-01.

Plus prices live in one shared list used only by the member app; no admin app, HQ, receipt or message shows or records them, so HQ cannot match Play payouts (existing FN-L5-phone-screens-2-02). A plan bought yearly can read as monthly (existing FN-L5-phone-screens-1-04). The prices set in Play Console itself were not opened (outside this code area).
